messages:
Asha (Partnerships): 👋 Quick sync: HaloChip wants a joint marketplace listing + SI-managed BYO-KMS option. Need SSO/SCIM/KMS signoff and a go-live checklist. Who can lead security certs?
Diego (Security): I can take security certs. Need SAML metadata exchange and HSM attestation docs from HaloChip. Also KMS key lifecycle requirements.
Maya (Eng-ML): From runtime side, BYO-KMS means we need envelope encryption flow + fallback keys in case customer KMS is unreachable. Can we get the KMS API swagger?
Ravi (SI): HaloChip SI team will handle the connector. I can share the connector plan but need SCIM attribute mapping and sample org data. Will also require a test VPC and test keys.
Tom (Product): Timeline ask: marketing wants the announcement in 6 weeks. That means partner legal + security + marketplace listing must be done in 4 weeks to leave 2 weeks buffer. Is that feasible? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Asha (Partnerships): Legal already asked HaloChip for NDA addendum. @Diego any blockers for the 4 week security window?
Diego (Security): Main blockers: HSM FIPS cert copy, KMS key wrap alg support (RSA-OAEP/SHA256), and SCIM provisioning idempotency tests. If HaloChip provides docs this week we should be OK.
Ravi (SI): I'll request the HSM certs today. Also note: some customers require PKCS#11 interface; HaloChip has both REST KMS and PKCS#11 shim. Need to decide which the marketplace listing supports.
Maya (Eng-ML): For runtime testing, sample commands we need from SI:
```
# smoke test for key unwrap
curl -X POST https://halo-kms.test/unwrap -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Also an integration checklist: prefix caching + KV eviction, fallback key path, latency under 15ms for unwrap calls under 99th percentile.
Asha (Partnerships): Noted. @Tom can you confirm marketing date flexibility if any of the certs slip?
Tom (Product): We can move announcement by a week if needed, but prefer not to. We'll stagger: marketplace listing first (soft), then press once SLA & KMS attestation are complete.
Diego (Security): I'll make a minimal test matrix and post in this thread by EOD. It will include: SAML metadata validation, SCIM create/update/delete idempotency, KMS unwrap latency and key rotation behavior, HSM attestation verification.
Halobot: Deployment triggered: marketplace-preview -> staging at 1789254500 by ci-bot. Status: queued.
Maya (Eng-ML): CI note: please include a test that simulates KMS timeouts to ensure our fallback path logs correctly. Example: set KMS_TIMEOUT=50ms in env for test run.
Ravi (SI): SCIM mapping request sent to HaloChip, sample payload included. Also asked for a service account with scim:write scope in their sandbox.
Asha (Partnerships): Action items summary:
- Diego: security test matrix + attestation checklist (due in 48h)
- Ravi: get HSM certs + service account + SCIM sample (due 24h)
- Maya: add KMS timeout tests to integration job (due 48h)
- Tom: draft marketplace blurb and soft-launch plan (due 72h)
Diego (Security): I'll upload the matrix here once done. If HaloChip can't provide PKCS#11 attestation, we may require an on-prem shim for certain customers.
Tom (Product): FYI — legal flagged embargo requirements for joint statement. Please route all quote requests through me.
Asha (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with HaloChip PM to nudge docs. Ping here if you need escalation. :thumbsup:
Ravi (SI): Received. I'll post certs and sandbox creds when HaloChip confirms.
Halobot: marketplace-preview -> staging deployment started at 1789254600. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/halochip-preview/459
Maya (Eng-ML): Quick question: for the fallback key, are we storing it encrypted with customer KMS or with our dedicated key? We should prefer customer-managed when available.
Diego (Security): Security preference: customer-managed primary; our dedicated key only as a constrained fallback (audited access, rotation policy).
Asha (Partnerships): Great. Closing loop — next check-in in 24h.
